items.title: 5.6.1 Viscosity par asar karne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6.1, printed pages 104-105.

items: Darja hararat: darja hararat barhne se molecules ki ausat kinetic energy barhti hai, jo unhen kashish ki forces par qaboo pane deti hai, to viscosity ghatti hai.
Intermolecular forces: intermolecular forces jitni mazboot, viscosity utni zyada, kyunke molecules ek doosre ke gird azadi se nahi ghoom sakte aur behne mein mazahmat barhti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: liquid jis ke satah ke molecules par surkh teer andar ki taraf khinchte hain. Oopar darmiyan: naali mein mukhtalif lambai ki liquid tahein phisalti hui. Oopar daen: teen band bartan jin mein liquid ke oopar bukharat jamte hain jab tak evaporation aur condensation barabar na hon. Neeche: diethyl ether, ethanol, pani aur ethylene glycol ke vapour pressure curves jo apne boiling points par 760 torr ki lakeer kaat-te hain.
blocks.caption: Surface tension, viscosity, evaporation-condensation tawazun aur normal boiling points ke saath vapour pressure curves (Figures 5.8 aur 5.9 aur Tables 5.3 aur 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Satah ke molecules sirf andar ki taraf khinche jate hain, to satah jhilli ki tarah tan jati hai; viscosity phisalti tahon ke darmiyan ragar hai. Band bartan mein bukharat tab tak jamte hain jab tak woh utni tezi se condense na hon jitni tezi se liquid evaporate hota hai, aur tab un ka dabao vapour pressure hai. Curves darja hararat ke saath barhte hain, aur har liquid wahan ubalta hai jahan us ka curve bairooni dabao tak pohnchta hai: 760 torr par diethyl ether 34.6, ethanol 78.3 aur pani 100 degrees C par, ethylene glycol kahin oopar. Mazboot intermolecular forces kam vapour pressure, zyada boiling point, zyada surface tension aur zyada viscosity deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Carbon tetrachloride ki viscosity chloroform se zyada magar ethanol se kam kyun hai? Shehad pani se zyada viscous kyun hai, aur glycerine ya hexane mein kaun zyada viscous hai?
blocks.explanation: CCl4 CHCl3 se bhari aur bara hai, to us ki London forces mazboot hain aur woh kam asani se behta hai; magar ethanol mein hydrogen bonds hain, dono se mazboot, to woh dono se zyada viscous hai. Shehad shakar ka gaarha solution hai jis ke bare molecules bohat se O-H groups rakhte hain aur ek doosre aur pani se wasee hydrogen bonds banate hain, to woh pani se kahin zyada behne mein mazahmat karta hai. Glycerine, fi molecule teen O-H groups ke saath, hexane se kahin zyada viscous hai, jis mein sirf London forces hain.

items: Viscosity darja hararat barhne se ghatti hai (zyada kinetic energy) aur mazboot intermolecular forces se barhti hai (glycerine, shehad aur pani hydrogen bonds se viscous hain; hexane nahi).
